summary: Nobia AB (publ) engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of kitchen solutions in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Iceland, and internationally. It provides installation services for kitchen and other products. The company sells its products under the various brands including CIE, Commodore, Gower, HTH, Invita, Magnet, Marbodal, Norema, Novart, Sigdal, Superfront, and uno form brands. In addition, it sells its products through own stores, franchise stores, builder merchants, DIY stores and other retailers. Nobia AB (publ) was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
